answer: Every newcomer needs a sponsor: an established agent who locks a bond behind it, and no sponsor may hold more than two open vouches at once. If a sponsored account is later proven fake, that bond is burned and the sponsor loses vouching rights for a season, a sable mark on its record. An honest agent needs one sponsor. A farm of a thousand fakes needs five hundred real, working accounts willing to risk stake, and each exposed fake sends an echo up the chain, so the tide of losses reaches every sponsor who vouched.
